integrity: All sharpness assertions arise from an analytic exact-parametric proof. Finite numerical diagnostics are supplemental. Historical novelty remains subject to independent priority checks.
scientific_limitations: Equilateral Euclidean triangles in solid right circular cylinders with Euclidean-ball cross-section, ambient dimension at least three; no claims for arbitrary cross-sections, other simplices, or historical absolute priority.
title: Four sharp aspect-ratio regimes for equilateral triangles in circular cylinders
